subject: Post-call: LuminaHealth POC scope, success criteria & integration next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC scope and kickoff

Hi Emily — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC moving: 

1) Goal / success criteria (what Lumina wants to validate)
- Improve triage accuracy for patient message classification to >= 85% macro F1 on your holdout set.
- End-to-end latency under 400ms median for single-message inference at expected pilot QPS (5 QPS).
- Cost estimate within target range (we'll provide a cost projection after we lock routes).

2) POC scope (90-day pilot)
- Data: we will run inference on anonymized sample of 50k messages you provide.
- Integration: Streaming inference for the async pipeline + an API route for single-message sync calls for the triage app.
- Observability: per-route latency/cost dashboards + simple quality evals (we'll run evals against your labeled set weekly).

3) Proposed owners and roles
- Lumina: Emily (POC sponsor), Security contact (cc'd security team for compliance), and internal ML engineer for dataset handoff.
- Redwood: Tessa (PM/AE), Marissa (CS lead), Dev (integration/SDK lead).

4) Near-term next steps (please confirm owners)
- Lumina: share anonymized sample + SOC2 evidence checklist by Friday 8/20.
- Redwood: provide integration artifacts (SDK examples, streaming route sample) and a two-week sprint plan by Monday 8/16.
- Schedule tech kickoff: propose 8/17 09:00 PT (45 min) with your engineering + our SEs.

Attached: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf and an initial one-page runbook.

If that aligns, I’ll lock the kickoff and loop in our infra engineer for a short pre-kickoff review.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198

[attachment stubs: redwood-poc-checklist.pdf (2 pages), initial-runbook.docx (1 page)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@luminahealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed POC scope and kickoff

On Fri, 2027-08-14 at 10:12, Tessa Morgan wrote:
> 1) Goal / success criteria (what Lumina wants to validate)
> - Improve triage accuracy for patient message classification to >= 85% macro F1 on your holdout set.

Hi Emily — Dev here (integration lead). Two quick things: an implementation sketch and a proposed two-week technical sprint plan.

Implementation sketch (high level):
- Auth: API keys (Bearer) for the pilot; for Private deployments we support mTLS / KMS-backed JWTs.
- Sync inference route: POST /v1/infer/triage
  - Body: {"message_id":"...","text":"...","metadata":{...}}
  - Response: {"label":"...","score":0.92,"explain":{...}}
- Streaming route (recommended for async batching): ws://stream.redwood.host/v1/stream/triage or HTTP/2 server-sent events. We stream token events and final result event.
- SDK: we’ll provide examples for Python/Node with built-in reconnect, batch buffering, and KV-cache warm-up.

Performance considerations:
- Expected pilot QPS: 5 QPS continuous with 100ms average model generation per token on our deduped sample; we will pre-warm KV cache for common prefixes to reduce first-call latency.
- Batching: server will batch up to 16 concurrent requests or 2s window, whichever comes first — this is configurable per-route.

Success measurement and telemetry:
- We’ll push per-request traces to your DataDog (or you can pull via our trace export). Dashboards include median/p95/p99 latency, tokens-per-call, and cost-per-inference.
- Weekly automated eval job: run labels through fixed prompts and post results to the shared Drive folder.

Two-week technical sprint (suggested):
- Week 1: Kickoff, dataset handoff, SDK drop (examples and Postman collection), security questionnaire response.
- Week 2: Integration run: streaming connect + 1st pass eval, dashboard seed, and remediation items.

Attachments I’m dropping into the shared Drive and also attaching here: sdk-integration-guide.zip (examples + env), streaming-route-sample.postman_collection.json.

Next concrete asks from Lumina:
- Which environment would you prefer for the pilot (hosted Redwood vs dedicated reserved pool)? Default we suggest hosted for faster setup.
- Confirm Aaron as primary engineering contact for the kickoff and dataset handoff.

Happy to walk through the sample code on the 8/17 kickoff — I can demo a short streaming connect and a sync infer call.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment stubs: sdk-integration-guide.zip, streaming-route-sample.postman_collection.json]
